title: exec arguments (server "exec", tool "exec")
description: The arguments of mcp-exec's exec tool (ExecRequest in src/service.rs of github.com/r33drichards/mcp-exec, at the commit images/browser/flake.lock pins), which is input.arguments of the mcp_tools policy input when input.server is "exec" and input.tool is "exec". A policy is asked BEFORE the server parses anything: in a policy every field can be missing or of any type, and other fields can be present (the server ignores fields it does not know). images/browser/test/exec-smoke.mjs checks these properties against the packaged server.

cmd.description: A shell command line, run as sh -c <cmd> in the desktop's home directory with the desktop's environment. There is no separate program, argument list, working directory or environment: everything is in this string.

timeout.description: Seconds (not milliseconds) after which the shell is killed and the status becomes "timeout". No default and no maximum in the server.
